sources.label: My Morphe patches; mainly focused on financial and productivity/utility apps
sources.author: Aidan
patch_list: Dynamically adjusts header height and top padding on devices with camera cutouts or tall status bars so location selectors and action icons clear the camera hole.
Removes in-app promotional message campaigns and popups (OneSignal In-App Messages), neutralizes in-app review and rating prompts, and zeroes Google Play and Huawei Advertising IDs.
Neutralizes diagnostic telemetry, event logging, and user tracking (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Instana APM, Branch Metrics, and OneSignal session and outcome tracking).
Exposes the internal developer and diagnostics screen (Environment Settings) on the Welcome Screen, and allows booting directly with Debug Messages or Demo Mode enabled.
